description: Production, of additives and Other Hydrocarbons is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Production, of additives and Other Hydrocarbons 1990-2020. Data from United Nations Statistics Division. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Notes: Refer back to the original source for numbers estimated by the United Nations Statistics Division (numbers with symbol). Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Conventional Fuels. Its keywords are Production, Hydrocarbons, additives. The portal shows 2026-04-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
